pairs.en: A minimal full-viewport page built for live spectating — the belief bar, round counter, and progress bar update every 15 s while the simulation runs. pairs.en: A verifier fetches reproduce.json, SHA-256s the bytes, and compares to the on-chain config hash. Match = the simulation parameters have not been altered since anchoring.
